packages.title: Ofgem Boiler Upgrade Scheme Product Eligibility List — scope and status QA
facts: Ofgem updated the Boiler Upgrade Scheme Product Eligibility List on 23 July 2026.

Product eligibility is not evidence of installation, energy use or measured greenhouse-gas emissions at a property.

packages.title: Landfill methane: measurement and metrics — scope and status QA
facts: The Environment Agency published Landfill methane: measurement and metrics on 2 February 2026.
The project studied methods for measuring landfill methane emissions and considered regulatory uses of those measurements.
The project investigated two measurement methods for demonstrating landfill-gas management effectiveness.
Research on landfill measurement methods does not provide a measured methane value for every cadastral parcel.
No parcel methane value is inferred unless an actual relevant measurement is separately available and bound to the parcel.
